description: Make the Dashboard dynamic by fetching real data from Supabase instead of hardcoded values. Show real KPIs (active employees count, today's absences, pending requests) and recent absences from the database.
steps: Convert src/app/dashboard/page.tsx from a Server Component with hardcoded data to a 'use client' component that fetches real data from Supabase

Fetch and display: (1) Count of active employees (is_inactive = false), (2) Count of today's absences from year_calendar where absence_date = today, (3) Count of pending holiday_selections (status = 'PENDING'), (4) Recent absences list from year_calendar joined with employees and absence_codes (last 5 entries)
Keep the same visual layout and card design but replace hardcoded values with real data
Add a loading state while data is being fetched
Keep the 'Evenements a venir' section as a placeholder for now (future feature)
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows real employee count from Supabase
Dashboard shows real today's absence count
Dashboard shows real pending requests count
Recent absences list shows actual data from year_calendar
verification: npm run build passes without errors
findings: Converted dashboard from server component with hardcoded data to a client component fetching real data from Supabase. Used Promise.all for parallel queries. The year_calendar join with employees and absence_codes works via Supabase foreign key relationships. Build passes cleanly.
